summary: Plain-C contiguous-field clears/sets (x & ~field, x | field) now select p.bclr/p.bset with GCC-identical immediates and encodings. Root cause: the fork's plain-C patterns (fork commit f1b7aebff8c2) check the constant with TImmLeaf shiftedFlippedMask/shiftedMask, which never matches an ordinary Constant. Fix: ImmLeaf twins with an upstream-Zbs-style !isInt<12> guard, so andi/ori stay; 0xffff stays p.exthz (insn-tablegen commit). Second commit (codegen-core): TTI getIntImmCostInst reports these masks as free on PULP RV32, as upstream does for Zbs bclri/bseti, so constant hoisting no longer hides a mask used several times.
semantics: p.bclr rD,rs1,Is3,Is2 = rs1 & ~(((1<<(Is3+1))-1)<<Is2); p.bset = rs1 | same (GVSoC pulp_v2.hpp:1967 p_bclri_exec, :2041 p_bseti_exec; isa_lib/int.h:406-414)
gcc_behaviour: GAP9 GCC emits p.bclr/p.bset for every contiguous mask, single bits included and also masks that fit andi/ori (p.bclr 0,3 for x&~8). We keep andi/ori for those, as the task requires. GCC uses p.exthz for x&0xffff, and so do we.

upstream_reference: RISCVInstrInfoZb.td:61-72 (BCLRMask/SingleBitSetMask ImmLeaf with !isInt<12>), :526-529; RISCVTargetTransformInfo.cpp:212,:225 (bclri/bseti free immediates); RISCVInstrInfoXCV.td:730-741 (cv.bclr/cv.bset have intrinsic patterns only, no plain-C patterns) at llvmorg-20.1.8
other_errors_seen: GCC emits p.bclr/p.bset for masks that fit andi/ori too: 531 of GCC's 560 p.bclr and 55 of its 71 p.bset in the SDK spot check. We keep andi/ori there on purpose (same cycles, compressible), so the raw count gap vs GCC stays large. This is a policy choice, not a defect

(and x, 0xff) selects p.extbz where GCC uses andi 255 (survey: p.extbz 284 vs 0). This is a pre-existing pattern at RISCVInstrInfoXpulp.td (P_EXTBZ), not touched here; andi is compressible (c.andi cannot hold 255, so the size is equal) and the cycles are the same

The fork's register-operand bclr/bset/insert/extract patterns (widthMinus1 immediate / shift immediate forms) and the plain-C p.extractu/p.insert immediate patterns still use TImmLeaf mask/shiftedMask/flippedMask, so they are dead for plain C in the same way (the extract/insert parts belong to B94's other items; the task said not to touch the clip/extract patterns)
proposed_test: llvm/test/CodeGen/RISCV/xpulp-bclr-bset.ll (llc -mtriple=riscv32 -mattr=+xpulpv2): check `and i32 %x, -65281` -> p.bclr a0, a0, 7, 8; `and i32 %x, 2147483647` -> p.bclr a0, a0, 0, 31; `or i32 %x, 2048` -> p.bset a0, a0, 0, 11; `or i32 %x, -268435456` -> p.bset a0, a0, 3, 28; negative controls: `and i32 %x, -9` -> andi, `or i32 %x, 2047` -> ori, `and i32 %x, 65535` -> p.exthz, non-contiguous `and i32 %x, -65282` -> lui/addi/and; plus an opt -passes=consthoist test showing a repeated 0xffff00ff mask is not hoisted with +xpulpv2
